description: Source code for a library managing signal handling, file I/O, threading, and cleanup routines, likely part of a larger system for controlled logging or data management.

methods.name: crtl_log_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a certain log level is enabled based on current global settings.

methods.name: crtl_init
methods.description: Initializes the system, sets up files, pipes, threads, and signal handlers.

methods.name: crtl_fsync
methods.description: Synchronizes data to disk, either stdout or output file.

methods.name: crtl_term
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the system, stopping threads, closing files, and unregistering signals.

methods.name: crtl_signals_register
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for critical signals to ensure proper cleanup.

methods.name: crtl_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles signals by flushing data, cleaning up, and re-raising the signal.

methods.name: crtl_abort
methods.description: Performs signal-safe cleanup and flushes data when the program crashes or receives a termination signal.
